title: Self-Verifying Execution Kernel

state_reconstructor.description: Builds ExecutionState from runtimeTrace. Resolves module domains via runtime-local map.
state_reconstructor.key_type: ExecutionState = { activePath, modulesByDomain, entryPoint, lastHop, totalEvents }

verifier.description: 4 consistency rules: no-observe-in-execution, gateway-first-hop, no-shadow-execution, no-legacy-execution

drift_engine.description: Compares design graph (16 modules) vs actual execution state. Reports missing / unexpected / domain violations.
drift_engine.output: DriftReport { driftCount, missingCount, unexpectedCount, domainViolationCount, items[] }

verified.expected_drift: 16 missing modules (expected — test token doesn't reach providers)

what_changed: System now has self-awareness: runtimeTrace → reconstruct → verify → drift. CI is no longer external — it's part of the kernel.
next_on_deck: Phase 5.2: Wire verifier into post-execution hook (auto-verify after each gateway call)
Phase 5.3: Drift auto-report to file in reports/execution-graph/
Phase 6: Production monitoring — track drift trends over time
